pages.text: Every affix item has a $(9)Rarity$() associated with it. The rarity of the item determines how strong it will be, and what affixes will be applied to it.$(p)A higher rarity is always stronger than the last.

pages.title: Common
pages.text: A $(#808080)Common$() item is the most basic type of affix item.  Each one will always have a single stat bonus, and has a low chance to gain a second.

pages.title: Uncommon
pages.text: An $(#33FF33)Uncommon$() item is a step up from a common item, but still doesn't get any unique effects. These items always have two stat bonuses, and have a chance at a basic effect.$(p)They may also receive a single socket.

pages.title: Rare
pages.text: $(#5555FF)Rare$() items are where affixes begin to shine. These items receive two stat bonuses and a special effect, and have a chance at a second effect.$(p)They may also receive up to two sockets, and always have a small durability bonus.

pages.title: Epic
pages.text: $(#BB00BB)Epic$() items are on the cusp of greatness. They receive three stats, an effect, and always one $(9)Ability$(), with a chance at a second effect.$(p)They always have one or more sockets, and a stronger durability bonus.

pages.title: Mythic
pages.text: $(#ED7014)Mythic$() items were forged by a lost entity of great power. They receive four stats, two effects, and an $(9)Ability$().$(p)They have one or more sockets, and a significant durability bonus.$(p)$(#ED7014)Mythic$() items have additional bonuses not mentioned here.
